urllib3 2.0.0 release notes

BREAKING CHANGES
- Removed support for Python 2.7 and 3.6.
- `urllib3.contrib.pyopenssl` and `urllib3.contrib.ntlmpool` were removed.
- `HTTPResponse.getheaders()` and `getheader()` were removed; use `.headers` instead.
- The `strict` parameter of `HTTPConnection` was removed.
Applications that call the removed APIs will fail to import after upgrading.

requests 2.32.0 changelog

Improvements
- Verify certificate chains against the system trust store when available.
- Minor performance work in `Session.merge_environment_settings`.
Bugfixes
- Fix a rare `UnicodeDecodeError` when parsing malformed `Content-Disposition`.
No public API was removed or renamed in this release. Existing code continues to work.

NumPy 2.0.0 release notes

BREAKING CHANGES
- The C ABI changed; extension modules compiled against 1.x must be rebuilt.
- Removed aliases `np.float_`, `np.unicode_`, `np.Inf`, `np.NaN` and ~100 other names.
- `np.copy` no longer accepts the `subok` keyword positionally.
Downstream packages that were not rebuilt will raise ImportError at load time.

click 8.1.7 changelog

- Fix an issue where `shell_completion` emitted a spurious warning on zsh.
- `Context.get_parameter_source` no longer raises for parameters supplied by defaults map.
This is a bugfix release. No behaviour of documented public APIs changed.

Pydantic V2 migration notes

BREAKING CHANGES
- `BaseModel.dict()` and `.json()` are deprecated in favour of `.model_dump()` / `.model_dump_json()`.
- `@validator` is replaced by `@field_validator` with a different signature.
- `Config` inner class is replaced by `model_config`.
- `parse_obj_as` was removed.
Nearly every V1 model definition needs edits before it will import under V2.

Jinja2 3.1.4 changelog

- Security fix: the `xmlattr` filter now rejects keys containing spaces, `/`, `>` or `=`.
- No other user-visible change.
Templates that do not pass such keys to `xmlattr` render identically to 3.1.3.

SQLAlchemy 2.0 — what's new

BREAKING CHANGES
- The 1.x `Query` style is legacy; `select()` + `Session.execute()` is the supported form.
- Implicit autocommit was removed; a transaction must be begun explicitly.
- `Engine.execute()` and `Connection.execute()` with a plain string were removed;
  wrap SQL text in `text()`.
Code relying on implicit autocommit or bare-string execute will raise at runtime.

attrs 23.2.0 changelog

- `attrs.validators.in_` now reports the offending value in its error message.
- Type stubs updated for `attrs.field`.
No deprecations took effect and no public API was removed in this release.

Flask 3.0.0 changelog

BREAKING CHANGES
- Dropped support for Python 3.7.
- Removed the deprecated `__version__` attribute.
- Removed `flask.Markup` and `flask.escape`; import them from `markupsafe`.
- The `app.before_first_request` decorator was removed.
Applications using `before_first_request` will fail to start after upgrading.

certifi 2024.07.04 changelog

- Updated the bundled Mozilla CA root store: 3 roots added, 5 expired roots removed.
The package exposes the same single function `certifi.where()`; the API is unchanged.

Werkzeug 3.0.0 changelog

BREAKING CHANGES
- Dropped support for Python 3.7.
- Removed the deprecated `__version__` attribute.
- `Request.get_data(as_text=True)` now decodes as UTF-8 strictly and raises on invalid bytes.
- Removed `werkzeug.urls.url_quote` and the rest of the legacy `urls` helpers.
Middleware importing `werkzeug.urls.url_quote` will fail to import.

packaging 24.1 changelog

- `packaging.metadata` gained a `RawMetadata` alias.
- Improved error messages from `Specifier` parsing.
No public API was removed; 24.1 is a drop-in replacement for 24.0.
